name: Triple Schezwan Rice
subtitle: fried rice, noodles and a schezwan gravy on one plate, the Bombay street order

ingredients.qty: 10, soaked and ground to a paste
ingredients.note: the schezwan paste; buy it if you prefer

ingredients.qty: 6 tbsp, plus 300ml for frying the noodles

prepNotes: Three things on one plate: rice at the bottom, gravy over it, crisp noodles on top. Assembled at the last moment.
Use cold, day-old rice. Warm rice turns to paste in the pan.

steps.text: Fry the boiled noodles in hot oil until crisp and golden. Drain and set aside.
In 3 tbsp oil, fry half the garlic hard, add half the vegetables, then the cold rice and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Toss on high 4 minutes.
steps.tip: Highest heat you have. Fried rice is a heat technique, not a recipe.

steps.text: For the gravy, fry the rest of the garlic in 3 tbsp oil, add the chilli paste and fry 3 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the remaining vegetables, soy sauce, vinegar and water. Boil, then thicken with slaked cornflour.
Plate the rice, ladle the gravy over, and pile the crisp noodles on top. Scatter spring onion and serve at once.
steps.tip: Assemble at the table. The noodles go soft in about two minutes.

storage: The components keep 2 days refrigerated separately. Cool the rice quickly and refrigerate within two hours. Assembled, it does not keep at all.
